add_subclass_configs: add subclass model configuration options to a Detectron2 config node for subclass prediction
create_subclass_fetcher: create a custom SubclassFetcher subclass and register it with SUBCLASS_FETCHER_REGISTRY for fetching subclass IDs
build_subclass_head: build a fully connected subclass prediction head with configurable layers using build_subclass_head
use_subclass_dataset_mapper: use SubclassDatasetMapper to encode ground truth subclass labels into instances during training
use_standard_roi_heads_with_subclass: use StandardROIHeadsWithSubClass to add subclass prediction to a standard ROI heads model
